goals.objective: 결제시스템 관련된 모든 내용을 삭제해줘. 이 프로젝트에서는 더이상 결제 기능을 사용하지 않아.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP call: start Next dev server on 127.0.0.1:3210, then run curl -i against /api/subscription, /api/portone/billing-key, /api/webhooks/portone, /api/cron/billing. PASS only if all four return HTTP/1.1 404 or HTTP/2 404 and no billing handler body.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-http-payment-routes.txt | four removed payment API endpoints returned HTTP/1.1 404; cleanup recorded

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use: start Next dev server on 127.0.0.1:3211, open /ko/settings and /ko/admin-portal-v5-secret in a real browser context. PASS only if visible text contains no 결제, 구독, Billing, Subscription, Pricing, 요금제 and there is no link href containing pricing, subscription, portone, billing.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-browser-ui-payment-removed.md | Browser plugin Chrome opened /ko/settings and /ko/admin-portal-v5-secret on port 3000; no forbidden visible text or links

successCriteria.scenario: tmux CLI: run npm ls @portone/browser-sdk @portone/server-sdk, rg payment/billing allowlist scans, npx vitest run tests/payment-removal.test.ts, npm run lint, npm run build. PASS only if PortOne deps are absent, allowed-scan has no active payment code, tests/lint/build pass.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-tmux-build-and-scan.txt | updated: command strings included; package-lock and pnpm-lock scan clean; targeted/full vitest, lint, build pass
